explain.title: How do ads work?
explain.body: Promote one of your publications so it appears in Featured, segmented by location and age. You choose an objective, a budget and how long it runs.
explain.reach: A higher budget means more reach and priority: campaigns with more balance are shown first. When the balance runs out, the campaign ends automatically. Minimum {minBudget}. Real card charging will be enabled with the payment gateway; for now it activates without charge.
explain.creditReturn: If your campaign ends before spending everything, the unspent balance is returned as reusable credit for future campaigns.
explain.refundPolicy: Important: we do not issue card or cash refunds. Returns are made only as internal reusable ad credit for future campaigns. Credit does not expire, is not transferable and cannot be exchanged for money.

destacar.title: Feature - {cost} / impression
destacar.description: It is shown near the top with the Sponsored label. Each time it is shown to someone in the target audience, {cost} is deducted. Example: Q10 ~= {small} views, Q1000 ~= {large} views.

mensajes.title: Messages - {cost} / click
mensajes.description: Shows a Send message button. It is only deducted when someone clicks. Example: Q10 ~= {small} contacts, Q1000 ~= {large} contacts.

credit.label: My ad credit
credit.available: Available for your next campaign. It cannot be exchanged for money.
credit.empty: You do not have credit yet. It is generated from unspent budget when campaigns end.
